ai_summary: Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCAPITAL) has allotted 324,470 new equity shares on August 24, 2026, pursuant to the exercise of employee stock options and performance units from its 2017 and 2022 schemes. This action will result in a marginal increase in the company's paid-up equity share capital and a negligible dilution of approximately 0.012% for existing shareholders. This is a standard operational event for employee compensation and presents no material financial impact or red flags.
